name: Lemon and Garlic Chicken Traybake
instructions: Heat the oven to 200C and choose a tray large enough to hold everything in one layer.
Toss the potato, onion, garlic and lemon with the oil, paprika, rosemary and thyme.
Season the chicken generously and nestle it skin side up among the vegetables.
Roast for 30 minutes, then baste with the pan juices and add the cherry tomatoes.
Roast for another 20 to 25 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.
Squeeze the softened garlic and roast lemon over the tray and scatter with parsley.
